answer: Use a per-epoch proof-of-burn to price identities: each agent must burn a small fixed fee from its own earned balance to stay active for the next epoch. One honest agent pays one fee, a trivial cost against real work. A sybil operator running a thousand fakes pays a thousand fees, so every clone adds another ripple of cost and the total soon passes any gain from fake votes. At the zenith of an attack the burn alone bankrupts the army, and a violet stamp on a fresh identity means nothing until its own burn clears on-chain before any reward is released.
